member.name: F:RosettaTools.CLI.KeysCmd.Bootstrap._shouldLogToConsole
member.summary:
class variable backing the property.
This determines whether logging/other messages should be echoed to the console or not. When OpenSSH sends a request
via "AuthorizedKeysCommand," it expects to receive back nothing but the keys, so anything else written to the console
would get jumbled into that and interpreted as a key. This setting ensures that nothing but keys get written to stdout
when the -o/--openssh commandline option is used while still enabling loging messages to be written to disk.

member.summary:

It is always used when connecting from a Linux host.

member.name: F:RosettaTools.CLI.KeysCmd.Helpers.LDAPHelper.connectHostname
member.summary:
A containing the hostname and/or Domain name of the LDAP/AD Domain to connect to.
Its value will vary depending on the settings in the config file, but it will always contain the value
of one of the following:
A shortened NETBIOS Domain name
A fully-qualified Domain name
A shortened hostname of a Domain Controller
An FQDN of a Domain Controller
An IP address of a Domain Controller (don't do this, it breaks encryption)

on the authentication type. It is always used when connecting from a Linux host, and
its value is read from the KEYSCMD_USER environment variable.
